locations.title: Locations
locations.subtitle: Warehouses, areas, racks and slots. Units are placed grouping similar ones together.
locations.nothing_to_place: There are no units waiting to be placed
locations.empty_hint: Create a warehouse and then its areas and racks.
locations.pick: Choose a warehouse, area or rack
locations.pick_hint: Select an item in the tree to see its occupancy and edit it.
locations.confirm_delete_msg: It can only be deleted when empty. If it contains units or items, move or delete them first.
locations.no_slots: This rack has no slots. Edit it to define its levels.
locations.code_hint: Short, no spaces or “/”. It forms each slot's code.
locations.preferred_hint: Smart placement will prefer this area for those equipment types.
locations.layout_hint: Define how many levels (floors) it has, how many slots per level and how many units fit in each slot.

rule.title: Level rule
rule.hint: Define which equipment type and grades go on this level and how they are grouped (in the order you choose).
rule.group_hint: Units with the same properties are kept together, starting with the first in the list.
rule.strict: One slot = one group (do not mix)
